Hello again weekend team,
Pet carriers, before opening: a short note from our desk

Please review every companion travel file with care before you give guidance at the counter. Our tone should stay calm, clear, and reassuring, and our instructions must be practical enough for passengers to follow without strain. When a traveler arrives with a pet, confirm the carrier meets our current standards, then explain the boarding steps in plain language and avoid adding unnecessary detail. <<FACT F034>> Keep the conversation focused on safety, comfort, and readiness so the passenger leaves with a simple next action.

If a case involves a special route or an unusual request, bring the file to the senior coordinator before you promise anything. <<FACT F042>> We should never guess, and we should never let a rushed answer replace a careful check. Use the approved notes, speak with courtesy, and make sure the traveler understands what will happen next. A brief, accurate explanation now prevents confusion later and supports dependable companion travel across Aurelia Skyways.

Thank you for keeping the desk steady, attentive, and kind throughout the weekend.
Companion Animal Travel Desk
